description: P(model has an exact reference CDS) for ab initio runs (Tiberius + Vipsania candidates, no protein and no RNA-Seq evidence). HistGradientBoostingClassifier depth 3, 400 iterations, learning rate 0.05, trained on the keep-all pools of 15 validation species without any extrinsic evidence (clade-agnostic): features of the tools, the structure and the locus context only. raw = baseline + sum of leaf values; P = 1 / (1 + exp(-raw)). Node test: x <= thr -> left; NaN -> left if nan_left else right. Thresholds: the species-out cross-validation optimum 0.30 / 0.25, also for clades outside the HC table. On 31 benchmark species: 49.4 transcript / 63.9 gene F1, Tiberius alone 47.9 / 59.2, Vipsania alone 44.2 / 54.8 (Nov 2026).
